entities.name: Acute proximal DVT
observations: For confirmed acute proximal lower-extremity DVT with temporary contraindication to anticoagulation, consider a retrievable IVC filter; reassess and begin anticoagulation when safe.

entities.name: Retrievable IVC filter
observations: Selective temporary option for established acute VTE when therapeutic anticoagulation is contraindicated; plan retrieval and anticoagulation when safe.

entities.name: Post-craniotomy DVT management
observations: Four days after subdural hematoma evacuation, avoid empiric therapeutic anticoagulation while bleeding risk remains prohibitive; for confirmed proximal DVT, consider a temporary filter and resume anticoagulation after neurosurgical clearance.
